# AuraPOS
> Next-Generation Kinetic Salon Billing & Studio Management OS

AuraPOS is a high-speed salon operating system engineered for studios, salons, and luxury spas. It features 0.3-second POS thermal checkouts, multi-stylist commission calculation, GST invoicing, client self-service booking portals with vanity URLs (`/b/<slug>`), and comprehensive business analytics.

## Core Capabilities
- **Kinetic POS & Thermal Billing**: Instant hotkey-driven search, multi-staff split assignments, split payment methods (Cash, UPI, Card), and customized thermal printing (80mm & 58mm).
- **Client Self-Booking Portal**: Unique salon vanity links (`/b/<slug>`) with 24/7 client booking, real-time availability, and zero commission fees.
- **Automated Stylist Commissions**: Dynamic revenue attribution and commission calculations.
- **GST & Tax Compliance**: 18% CGST/SGST automated calculation, tax breakdowns, and one-click monthly CSV export.
- **Security & Session Control**: Role-based access control (Admin, Manager, Stylist), session token authentication with configurable timeouts (30 mins to never), and autosaving configuration.

## Pricing Tiers
- **Free Trial**: 14-day full access, single seat, AuraPOS watermark on receipts.
- **Pro**: ₹69/month (or ₹690/year), multi-seat, unbranded receipts with salon phone.
- **Studio**: ₹149/month (or ₹1,490/year), unlimited seats, custom salon logo on receipts, salon address, advanced reports, and data export/import.
